title: SCOTT Addict RC 40 model 290362: identity and manual scope correction
notes: Exact page identifies Addict RC 40 model 290362, race geometry and a 1 1/4–1 1/2 inch fork steerer. The separately reopened 2026 Addict manual names Addict, describes a 1 inch steerer, 418 mm chainstays and a storage kit, and does not identify model 290362. Its 38 mm maximum and geometry must not be transferred based on matching size labels. Exact page supports BB-RS500-PB and stock 700x28C tires only; the navigation year does not date this model generation.
